invariants.title: Pure-Stdlib Core Kernel
invariants.detail: core/livelab/ runs strictly on Python standard library with zero third-party, torch, or engine dependencies, enforced by AST checks across all engine labs via rsibox doctor.

invariants.title: Zero Cross-Engine Imports
invariants.detail: Each engine adapter under repos/<engine>/livelab/ stays strictly isolated behind the shared 5-verb INTERFACE.md contract (install, check, reset, uninstall, status) with zero cross-engine imports.

invariants.title: Two-Ledger Witness Proof
invariants.detail: Witness separates live counts from capture_counts (plus generation-matched GraphReplayGuard crediting for Tier-A patched graphs), refusing unexecuted startup-only edits as proven=False (zero_witness).

invariants.title: Deterministic S0 Rollback
invariants.detail: Journaled undo and S0 state/RNG resets achieve max_abs_logprob_diff == 0.0 across inference engines and max_abs_loss_diff == 0.0 across Megatron-LM, veRL, miles, and TorchTitan FSDP2.

invariants.title: Fail-Closed Transaction Refusal
invariants.detail: Conformance c5/c6 verifies fail_apply, fail_commit, patch_invalid, closure_changed, outside_changes, empty_change, captured_target, and constructor_edit roll back or refuse before mutating live state.

invariants.title: SHA-256 Hash-Chained Pool Traces
invariants.detail: Every SandboxPool lease writes an append-only JSONL record chaining prev_sha256 -> record_sha256; verify_trace(..., expected_head=...) passed 112/112 traces across 3,226 real B200 leases.

invariants.title: Priority + Anti-Starvation Aging + Elastic Role Borrowing
invariants.detail: SandboxPool priority (#226), tunable priority_aging_s (#233, 2.07x lower Dev max starvation wait), and work-conserving fallback_roles (#237, 1.60x-1.65x Triad, 2.60x Phase-Shift) eliminate starvation with zero primary-role theft.

invariants.title: Per-Agent Circuit Breaker & max_slots_per_agent
invariants.detail: Per-agent max_agent_faults quarantine (#243, 3.08x lower recovery downtime) paired with max_slots_per_agent=1 (#250) bounds multi-threaded rogue blast radius to 1/3 GPU and delivers 12.40x healthy team speedup.

invariants.title: Online Slot Rehabilitation (heal_slot) & Elastic Scaling (add_slot/drain_slot)
invariants.detail: heal_slot() (#253) rehabilitates quarantined slots online while add_slot()/drain_slot() (#256) scale pools live under load (3->2->3 EXP-H4: 0.176 s drain, 58 us attach, 0 aborted edits).

invariants.title: Multi-Shadow Early-Wake Guard (StandbyShadowDriver)
invariants.detail: ready_count_fn + AsyncShadowReplenisher.wait(..., until=...) (#244/#247/#248) skips false in_flight stalls when parked shadows exist, cutting vLLM Restart #2 by 30.60x (EXP-G2b) and SGLang sh2 promote to 0.484 s (EXP-G2c).

invariants.title: Sub-Millisecond Unassisted SIGKILL Fast-Fail
invariants.detail: alive_fn peer-liveness checks + transport_error=True (#229/#230/#235) eliminate dead-channel timeout stalls, cutting cleanup latency to 0.502 ms on vLLM (358,566x vs 180 s timeout) and 0.173 ms on TRT-LLM (346,821x vs 60 s timeout).

invariants.title: Facts Consistency & Leak-Free CI
invariants.detail: verify_facts.py --strict enforces 0 schema/math/join errors and 0 split-brain drifts across 7 fact files and 10 repo engines alongside site/build.py --check, leak-check.sh, and -W error::ResourceWarning CPU test suites (including 24/24 warm checks).

experiments.title: Multi-Agent Contention Matrix (C in {1,2,3} x N in {1,2,4,8})
experiments.result: 43.7x-54.4x clean speedup (68.3-190.4 edits/min vs 1.31-3.82 FIFO restart); 1 B200 at N=8 beats 3 restarting B200s at N=6 by 19.2x; 28.7x lower mean queue wait at C=1, N=4; max_abs_logprob_diff == 0.0.

experiments.title: Multi-Agent Team Topologies (Monolithic, Dev+Eval Split, 3-Pool Triad)
experiments.result: 27 cells (324 pipeline runs): 66.7% 1st-pass -> 100.0% post-Toolsmith completion (10/12 proven + 2/12 host-config); dedicated Eval eliminates stalls (0/12, 0.000 s wait) while static 1:1:1 caps at 40.4-42.4 ideas/min.

experiments.title: vLLM & SGLang Standby Shadow Crash Failover (C=1, N in {4,8})
experiments.result: vLLM live SIGKILL recovery drops 36.27-39.98 s -> 0.677-0.752 s (53.2x-53.6x, 3.91x-6.99x burst throughput, 12.75x-24.59x p95 wait); SGLang eager recovery drops 11.41-11.52 s -> 0.449-0.490 s (23.5x-25.4x).

experiments.title: Proportional 2-Eval:1-Dev Split & Priority Shared Pool Sizing (3x B200)
experiments.result: 2 Eval : 1 Dev+Toolsmith lifts throughput +53% to +61% over 1:1:1 triad (64.0-67.2 ideas/min, 0/12 Eval stalls); priority_shared reaches 76.3-80.7 ideas/min with 4.68x-8.65x lower mean Eval wait.

experiments.title: Continuous 3-Crash SIGKILL Stress with AsyncShadowReplenisher
experiments.result: 3 consecutive live SIGKILL crashes recovered in 0.803 s, 0.726 s, and 0.647 s (2.176 s total downtime) with 208 R0 edits completed during background restock (154.69 proven edits/min, 99.997% util, 0 GMS errors).

experiments.title: Zero-Sleep Unassisted SIGKILL Fast-Fail (vLLM & TensorRT-LLM)
experiments.result: alive_fn liveness checks cut dead-channel cleanup to 0.502 ms on vLLM EXP-F1 (358,566x vs 180 s timeout, 0.805 s Shadow recovery, 137.59 edits/min) and 0.173 ms pre-send / 0.329 s quiesce on TRT-LLM EXP-F5 (346,821x vs 60 s RPC timeout).

experiments.title: SGLang 52-Decode-CG Standby Shadow + Targeted Shutdown
experiments.result: stop_sglang_engine_targeted + SglangShadowPromoter preserves all 52 decode CUDA graphs and co-process GMS (0 errors), cutting recovery 34.51x (18.417 -> 0.534 s), boosting throughput 4.67x (42.85 -> 200.16 edits/min), and cutting p95 wait 11.31x.

experiments.title: Anti-Starvation Priority Aging Under Sustained Eval Flood
experiments.result: priority_aging_s=0.30 cuts Dev max starvation wait 2.07x (14.620 -> 7.069 s) and moves Dev completion ranks from [1,22,23,24] to [1,10,12,20] with max_abs_logprob_diff == 0.0.

experiments.title: Work-Conserving Elastic Role Borrowing (3x B200 Triad & Phase-Shift)
experiments.result: fallback_roles boosts 1:1:1 Triad 1.60x-1.65x (60.4-66.2 vs 37.8-40.2 ideas/min; 0.000015 s Eval wait at N=4) and accelerates explore-then-validate Phase-Shift 2.60x vs static triad (31.6 -> 82.4 ideas/min) and 1.61x vs 2E+1D.

experiments.title: Cross-Framework 5-Engine SandboxPool & Priority Portability (incl. TorchTitan FSDP2)
experiments.result: Same SandboxPool priority=10/0 cuts Eval wait 7.08x on SGLang 52-CG (500.6 edits/min), 6.98x on TRT-LLM (486.5 edits/min), 5.47x on TorchTitan FSDP2 EXP-F6 (357.3 edits/min, max_abs_loss_diff == 0.0), and 7.21x on Transformers (89.7 edits/min).

experiments.title: TorchTitan 2-Rank FSDP2 NCCL Live-Lab (2x B200)
experiments.result: Real 2-rank NCCL fully_shard across 2x B200 achieves 21.63x speedup (5.515 s cold boot+check -> 0.255 s warm cycle: 0.1011 s install, 0.0535 s check, 0.0989 s undo+S0), max_abs_loss_diff == 0.0, and 11/11 conformance (239.00 s c0-c10).

experiments.title: Realistic LLM Think-Time Scaling & Little's Law Validation (1x-3x B200)
experiments.result: With t_hold ~ 0.34 s and t_think = 5.0 s, 1 B200 serves N=8 at 0.02 ms mean wait (90.83 edits/min, N*=15.47); at t_think = 3.0 s, 3 B200s sustain N=24 concurrent agents at 399.17 edits/min (0.132 s mean / 0.426 s p95 wait).

experiments.title: 50/50 Mixed Hot-Swap + Restart-Tier & Multi-Shadow Guard Fix (vLLM & SGLang)
experiments.result: 2.78x-2.82x vs plain GMS RO (6.89x vs 6x warm restarts); PR #244/#247 cuts vLLM Restart #2 by 30.60x (36.533 -> 1.194 s), mean wait 8.78x (1.516 s), p95 wait 13.22x (2.895 s); SGLang EXP-G2c promotes sh2 in 0.484 s (38.06x) with 52 CGs & 0 GMS errors.

experiments.title: Per-Agent Fault Circuit Breaker Under Rogue Poisoning Storm (3x B200)
experiments.result: Latched max_agent_faults=1 (#243) quarantines rogue_0 on fault #1 and rejects 2 repeat attacks in-lock, cutting real respawns 3 -> 1, GPU recovery downtime 3.08x (136.54 -> 44.32 s, -92.23 s), and campaign wall 3.07x.

experiments.title: Full-Stack 6-Layer Integration Under Active Eval-Slot Attack (3x B200)
experiments.result: All 6 layers active simultaneously cut 12-idea pipeline wall 11.30x (151.12 -> 13.37 s, 4.76 -> 53.86 ideas/min), Eval mean wait 23.60x (35.654 -> 1.511 s, p95 16.67x), total campaign wall 3.30x, and GPU recovery 2.93x.

experiments.title: Concurrent-Rogue Blast-Radius Containment via max_slots_per_agent=1 (3x B200)
experiments.result: Capping max_slots_per_agent=1 (#250) bounds simultaneous 3-thread rogue attack from 3/3 blackout to 1/3 GPU, accelerating healthy team 12.40x (54.32 -> 4.38 s, 273.97 edits/min), cutting p95 wait 60.58x, and cutting GPU recovery 3.31x.
